'''Mogrugg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] who resided in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He worked as a bodyguard for [[Wunda]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], and was a patron of the [[Thirsty Bantha]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. He planned to one day pursue his true passion: flower arranging.
